info.name: Get all definitions or filter by enum type

params.name: type
params.description: Enum type name (e.g. CellTechnologyTypeEnum). Omit to return all.

items.docs:
## Overview

This request calls the PlantPredict API **Definitions** endpoint to retrieve the list of available model definitions.

Ensure these variables are correctly set in the active environment before sending the request.

## Typical Use Cases

- Retrieve available model definitions before **creating** a new project.
    
- Look up model definitions prior to **updating** an existing project.
